stages.name: Death of a Patriot
stages.desc:
Original stage: Main Theme The Birth of Tragedy 7-18
A recreation of our first encounter with Patriot.

<Interference Mine> Upon explosion, deals heavy damage to the surrounding enemies and amplifies the damage they take for 15 seconds.
